<!-- wp:html -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@500;600;700;800&display=swap">
<style>
/* Colores al pasar el cursor: el tema pinta botones y enlaces de gris (13-nov-2026). */
a:hover,a:focus{color:inherit}
.h-btn-o:hover,.h-btn-o:focus{color:#fff}
.h-btn-l:hover,.h-btn-l:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-cab .h-btn:hover,.h-cab .h-btn:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-menu:hover,.h-menu:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-franja:hover,.h-franja:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-hero .h-btn-o:hover,.h-hero .h-btn-o:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-hero .h-btn-l:hover,.h-hero .h-btn-l:focus{color:#fff}
.h-tab:hover,.h-tab:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-tab[aria-selected=true]:hover,.h-tab[aria-selected=true]:focus{color:#fff}
.h-card:hover,.h-card:focus{color:inherit}
.h-fila:hover,.h-fila:focus{color:inherit}
.h-todos:hover,.h-todos:focus{color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-promo .h-btn:hover,.h-promo .h-btn:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-prod a:hover,.h-prod a:focus{color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-extra a:hover,.h-extra a:focus{color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-cerca:hover,.h-cerca:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-sede-a a:hover,.h-sede-a a:focus{color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-elegida button:hover,.h-elegida button:focus{color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-pie a:hover,.h-pie a:focus{color:#fff}
.h-legales a:hover,.h-legales a:focus{color:#D9D1C6!important}
.h-ver-mas:hover,.h-ver-mas:focus{color:var(--oro-o)}
@media (max-width:399px){.h-acc .h-wa-c:hover,.h-acc .h-wa-c:focus{color:#fff}}
.h-wa:hover,.h-wa:focus{color:#fff}
.h-sede:hover,.h-sede:focus{color:inherit}
.h-cerrar:hover,.h-cerrar:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-mas:hover,.h-mas:focus{color:var(--tinta)}
@media (min-width:860px){.h-barra .h-btn-o:hover,.h-barra .h-btn-o:focus{color:var(--tinta)}}

:root{--crema:#F4EEE6;--oro:#D2B676;--oro-o:#7A5C14;--tinta:#16161D;--suave:#55504A;--linea:#E5DED5;--blanco:#FFFDFA;--wa:#1F8F4E;color-scheme:light}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
/* Blindaje contra los estilos del sitio (Elementor y el tema) cuando va dentro de WordPress. */
body{font-weight:400!important;letter-spacing:normal;background:var(--blanco)!important}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:Montserrat,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif!important;text-transform:none}
b,strong{font-weight:700!important}
.h-res blockquote{font-weight:400!important;color:var(--tinta)!important;line-height:1.45!important;font-style:normal;border:0;padding:0;background:none}
.h-menu{font-family:Arial,sans-serif!important;font-weight:400!important;line-height:1!important;padding:0!important}
.h-rapida select{color:var(--tinta)!important}
button,select,input,summary{font-family:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--blanco);color:var(--tinta);font-family:Montserrat,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.45;padding-bottom:76px}
a{color:inherit}
.h-wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:21;background:var(--blanco)}
.h-cab{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:var(--blanco);border-bottom:1px solid var(--linea)}
.h-cab .h-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:56px}
.h-cab img{height:22px;width:auto}
.h-cab nav{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.h-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:999px;border:0;font:700 15px/1 Montserrat,Arial,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.h-btn-o{background:var(--tinta);color:#fff}
.h-btn-l{background:transparent;color:var(--tinta);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--tinta)}
.h-cab .h-btn{min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;font-size:14px;background:var(--oro);color:var(--tinta)}
.h-menu{width:44px;height:44px;border:0;background:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--tinta)}
.h-franja{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--oro);color:var(--tinta);text-decoration:none;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;padding:9px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) 9px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px))}
.h-franja s{color:rgba(22,22,29,.62);font-weight:500}
.h-fr-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-right:8px;padding:3px 9px 3px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--tinta);color:var(--oro);font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;vertical-align:1px}
.h-fr-pill::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#2EE66B;animation:h-anillo 1.6s ease-out infinite}
.h-fr-pill.h-hoy{background:#B3261E;color:#fff} .h-fr-pill.h-hoy::before{background:#fff;animation-name:h-anillo-b}
.h-cuando{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--oro)}
.h-punto{flex:none;margin-top:6px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:#2EE66B;animation:h-anillo 1.6s ease-out infinite}
.h-es-hoy .h-punto{background:#FF4D4D;animation-name:h-anillo-r}
@keyframes h-anillo{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(46,230,107,.75)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(46,230,107,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(46,230,107,0)}}
@keyframes h-anillo-r{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,77,77,.75)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(255,77,77,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,77,77,0)}}
@keyframes h-anillo-b{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(255,255,255,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.h-fr-pill::before,.h-punto{animation:none}}
.h-franja>span:last-child{font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--tinta);color:var(--oro);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12.5px}
.h-hero{background:var(--tinta);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.h-portada{position:absolute;inset:0}
.h-portada img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 40%;opacity:.5;display:block}
.h-hero .h-wrap{position:relative;padding-block:24px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.h-hero h1{font-size:28px;line-height:1.12;margin:0;font-weight:800;text-wrap:balance;max-width:16ch}
.h-hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(22,22,29,.55) 0%,rgba(22,22,29,.25) 55%,rgba(22,22,29,.45) 100%);pointer-events:none}
.h-hero .h-wrap{z-index:1}
.h-hero h1{letter-spacing:-.015em;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.h-h1b{color:var(--oro)}
.h-hero p{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:#F4EEE6}
.h-datos{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.h-motivos{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:4px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
.h-motivos li{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline}
.h-motivos li::before{content:"✓";color:var(--oro);font-weight:800}
.h-datos span{background:rgba(255,253,250,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,253,250,.28);padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.h-datos .h-g{background:var(--blanco);color:var(--tinta);border-color:var(--blanco)}
.h-g b{color:#B8860B;letter-spacing:1px}
.h-acc{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:8px}
.h-acc .h-cta{flex:1;min-height:50px;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 7px 0 18px;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.01em;
 background:linear-gradient(180deg,#E2C98F 0%,#CBAC64 100%);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.30),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5);transition:transform .15s}
.h-acc .h-cta:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.h-cta-t{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.h-cta-f{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tinta);color:var(--oro);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:17px}
.h-acc .h-btn-l{min-height:50px;padding:0 15px;font-size:14.5px;gap:7px;background:rgba(22,22,29,.28);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.h-hero .h-btn-o{background:var(--oro);color:var(--tinta)}
.h-hero .h-btn-l{color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px #fff}
section{padding-block:26px}
h2{font-size:21px;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 4px;font-weight:800;text-wrap:balance}
.h-sub{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--suave);font-size:14px}
.h-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px;margin:0 0 12px;scrollbar-width:none}
.h-tab{flex:none;border:1px solid var(--linea);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:0 16px;min-height:44px;font:600 14px Montserrat,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--tinta);cursor:pointer}
.h-tab[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--tinta);color:#fff;border-color:var(--tinta)}
.h-panel{display:grid;gap:10px}
.h-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:66px 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;text-align:left;width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--linea);border-radius:14px;background:#fff;font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.h-card img{width:66px;height:66px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover}
.h-card-t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0}
.h-card-t b{font-size:15px;line-height:1.2}
.h-card-p{font-weight:800}
.h-card-p i{font-style:normal;font-weight:500;color:var(--suave);font-size:13px}
.h-card-i{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--suave);line-height:1.3}
.h-card-b,.h-fila-a{background:var(--tinta);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 12px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.h-lista{gap:0;border:1px solid var(--linea);border-radius:14px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.h-fila{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:11px 12px;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--linea);background:none;font:inherit;color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.h-fila:first-child{border-top:0}
.h-fila-t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;min-width:0}
.h-fila-t span{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}
.h-fila-t i{font-style:normal;color:var(--suave);font-size:13px}
.h-fila-t i b{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-fila-a{background:none;color:var(--tinta);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--tinta);padding:8px 12px;flex:none}
.h-val{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:12px;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--crema);font-size:14px}
.h-val b{display:block}
.h-val button{flex:none}
.h-todos{display:block;margin-top:10px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-promo{background:var(--tinta);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;display:grid;gap:6px}
.h-promo p{margin:0}
.h-precio{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:4px 12px;margin:4px 0 2px}
.h-promo .h-pre{order:-1;font-size:40px;line-height:1;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.h-pre-a{color:#C9C2B8;font-size:14px} .h-pre-a s{font-weight:600}
.h-ahorro{color:#7EE2A0;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.01em}
.h-ahorro::before{content:"↓ ";font-weight:800}
.h-promo .h-btn{background:var(--oro);color:var(--tinta);justify-self:start;margin-top:6px}
.h-promo small{color:#C9C2B8;font-size:12.5px}
.h-porque{background:var(--crema)}
.h-kalli{background:var(--crema)}
.h-kalli-tag{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-prods{display:flex;gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding-bottom:6px;scrollbar-width:none}
.h-prod{flex:0 0 70%;max-width:280px;scroll-snap-align:start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:16px}
.h-prod img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
.h-prod i,.h-prod b,.h-prod span,.h-prod a{padding:0 16px}
.h-prod i{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-prod b{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.25}
.h-prod span{color:var(--suave);font-size:14px;flex:1}
.h-prod a{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--oro-o);min-height:32px;display:flex;align-items:center}
.h-kalli-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.h-extras{display:flex;gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding-bottom:6px;scrollbar-width:none}
.h-extra{position:relative;flex:0 0 74%;max-width:300px;scroll-snap-align:start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--linea);border-radius:16px;background:#fff}
.h-extra .h-ico{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tinta);color:var(--oro);display:grid;place-items:center}
.h-extra b{font-size:16px;line-height:1.25}
.h-extra>span:not(.h-ico){color:var(--suave);font-size:14px;flex:1}
.h-extra a{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-prop{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#FFFDFA 0 14px,#FBF6EE 14px 28px);border:1.5px dashed #CDBB98}
.h-prop i{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--oro-o);background:#F4EEE6;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 8px}
.h-aviso-s{padding-block:6px 20px}
.h-aviso{display:grid;gap:6px;padding:18px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--crema);border:1px solid var(--linea)}
.h-aviso p{margin:0}
.h-aviso-tag{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--oro-o)}
.h-aviso-t{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2}
.h-aviso .h-btn{justify-self:start;margin-top:6px}
.h-aviso-libre{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#FBF6EE 0 14px,#F6EFE4 14px 28px);border:2px dashed #CDBB98}
.h-porque ul{list-style:none;margin:12px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:14px}
.h-porque li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:start;align-content:start}
.h-porque .h-ico{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tinta);color:var(--oro);display:grid;place-items:center}
.h-porque li b{display:block}
.h-porque li div span{color:var(--suave);font-size:14px}
.h-ads{display:flex;gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding-bottom:6px;scrollbar-width:none}
.h-ad{margin:0;flex:0 0 82%;max-width:340px;scroll-snap-align:start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.h-ad figcaption{font-weight:700;font-size:14.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.h-ad-ej{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--oro-o);background:var(--crema);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 8px}
.h-ad-a svg,.h-ad-d svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.h-ad-caja{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--crema);cursor:pointer}
.h-ad-a,.h-ad-d{position:absolute;inset:0}
.h-ad-d{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 var(--x))}
.h-ad img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.h-ad-vacio{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:13px;color:var(--suave);text-align:center}
.h-ad-vacio b{font-size:18px;color:var(--tinta)}
.h-ad-v1{padding-right:50%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#EFE6DA 0 12px,#E8DDCF 12px 24px)}
.h-ad-v2{padding-left:50%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#F6EBD3 0 12px,#EFDFBC 12px 24px)}
.h-ad-linea{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:var(--x);width:3px;margin-left:-1.5px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(22,22,29,.15);pointer-events:none}
.h-ad-linea::after{content:"‹ ›";position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--tinta);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(22,22,29,.25)}
.h-ad-et{position:absolute;top:10px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(22,22,29,.72);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;pointer-events:none}
.h-ad-et1{left:10px} .h-ad-et2{right:10px}
.h-ad input{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:100%;height:2px;margin:0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.h-ad-mango{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:var(--x);width:56px;margin-left:-28px;touch-action:none;cursor:ew-resize;z-index:2}
.h-ad:focus-within .h-ad-linea::after{outline:2px solid var(--oro-o);outline-offset:2px}
.h-gal{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding-bottom:6px}
.h-gal figure{margin:0;flex:0 0 44%;max-width:200px;scroll-snap-align:start}
.h-gal img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;display:block}
.h-resenas{display:grid;gap:10px}
.h-nota{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin:0 0 12px}
.h-nota b{font-size:22px;white-space:nowrap}
.h-nota span{color:var(--suave);font-size:14px}
.h-res{margin:0;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--linea);border-radius:14px;background:#fff}
.h-est{color:#B8860B;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:14px}
.h-res blockquote{margin:6px 0;font-size:14.5px}
.h-res figcaption{font-size:13px;color:var(--suave);font-weight:600}
.h-zonas{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;margin:0 0 6px;scrollbar-width:none}
.h-sedes ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.h-sedes li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--linea)}
.h-sede-t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0}
.h-sede-t span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--suave);line-height:1.35}
.h-sede-t .h-zona{color:var(--oro-o);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.h-sede-t .h-hor{color:var(--tinta)}
.h-cerca{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:42px;margin:0 0 8px;padding:0 16px;border:1.5px solid var(--tinta);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--tinta);font:700 14px Montserrat,Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.h-cerca[aria-busy=true]{opacity:.55}
.h-cerca-msg{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--suave)}
.h-km{color:var(--oro-o);font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px}
.h-km:empty{display:none}
.h-sede.h-1 b::after{content:"La más cercana";display:table;margin:4px 0 0;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--oro);color:var(--tinta);font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.h-sedes li.h-1 .h-sede-t b::after{content:"La más cercana";display:table;margin:4px 0 2px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--oro);color:var(--tinta);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;vertical-align:2px}
.h-sede-t .h-est-s{color:var(--tinta);font-weight:700}
.h-sede-a{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;flex:none}
.h-sede-a .h-btn{min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;font-size:13.5px}

<script>
(function(){
var $=function(s){return document.querySelector(s)},$$=function(s){return document.querySelectorAll(s)};
var barra=$('#barra');new IntersectionObserver(function(e){barra.classList.toggle('ver',!e[0].isIntersecting);}).observe($('.h-hero'));
$$('.h-tab').forEach(function(t){t.addEventListener('click',function(){
 $$('.h-tab').forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(x===t));});
 $$('.h-panel').forEach(function(p){p.hidden=p.dataset.panel!==t.dataset.tab;});});});
var sede=null,capa=$('#capa'),ir=$('#hoja-ir'),hp=$('#hoja-p');
/* La agenda abre con el servicio y la sede ya elegidos. Sin & literal ni doble: WordPress los cambia. */
var AG='https://samsarahindu.es/agendar-cita/',Y=String.fromCharCode(38),serv=null;
function enlace(s,l){return AG+'?servicio='+encodeURIComponent(s)+Y+'sede='+encodeURIComponent(l);}
function marcar(l){$$('.h-sede').forEach(function(s){s.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(s.dataset.l===l));});
 var b=l?document.querySelector('.h-sede[data-l="'+l+'"]'):null;
 if(b){ir.href=enlace(serv,l);ir.setAttribute('aria-disabled','false');ir.textContent='Ver horarios en '+b.querySelector('b').textContent;}
 else{ir.setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');ir.textContent='Elige una sede';}}
function abrir(el){serv=el.dataset.s;hp.textContent=el.dataset.n+(el.dataset.p?' · '+el.dataset.p:'');capa.hidden=false;marcar(sede);}
$$('.h-card,.h-fila,.h-card-v,.h-promo-b').forEach(function(c){c.addEventListener('click',function(){abrir(c);});});
$$('.h-sede').forEach(function(s){s.addEventListener('click',function(){sede=s.dataset.l;marcar(sede);});});
capa.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===capa||e.target.classList.contains('h-cerrar'))capa.hidden=true;});
$$('.h-aqui').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){sede=b.dataset.l;$('#elegida-n').textContent=b.dataset.n;$('#elegida').hidden=false;
 document.getElementById('servicios').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});});});
$('#quitar-sede').addEventListener('click',function(){sede=null;$('#elegida').hidden=true;});
var rs=$('#r-serv'),rl=$('#r-sede'),ri=$('#r-ir');
function rev(){var ok=rs.value?!!rl.value:false;ri.href=ok?enlace(rs.value,rl.value):AG;ri.setAttribute('aria-disabled',ok?'false':'true');
 ri.textContent=ok?'Ver horarios en '+rl.options[rl.selectedIndex].text.split(' · ')[0]:'Ver horarios libres';}
rs.addEventListener('change',rev);rl.addEventListener('change',rev);
$$('.h-aqui').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){rl.value=b.dataset.l;rev();});});
var km=function(a,b,c,d){var r=Math.PI/180,x=Math.sin((c-a)*r/2),y=Math.sin((d-b)*r/2);return 12742*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(x*x+Math.cos(a*r)*Math.cos(c*r)*y*y));};
function ordenar(la,lo){
 [document.querySelector('#sedes ul'),document.querySelector('.h-sedes-h')].forEach(function(caja){
  var xs=[].slice.call(caja.children).map(function(e){return [km(la,lo,+e.dataset.lat,+e.dataset.lng),e];}).sort(function(a,b){return a[0]-b[0];});
  xs.forEach(function(x,i){var d=x[0];x[1].querySelector('.h-km').textContent='A '+(10>d?d.toFixed(1):Math.round(d)).toString().replace('.',',')+' km';
   x[1].classList.toggle('h-1',i===0);caja.appendChild(x[1]);});});
 var cerca=document.querySelector('.h-sedes-h .h-1');if(cerca){sede=cerca.dataset.l;marcar(sede);}
 $$('.h-cerca-msg').forEach(function(m){m.hidden=false;m.textContent='Ordenadas de la más cercana a la más lejana.';});}
$$('.h-cerca').forEach(function(btn){
 if(!navigator.geolocation){btn.hidden=true;return;}
 btn.addEventListener('click',function(){btn.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');
  navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function(p){btn.removeAttribute('aria-busy');ordenar(p.coords.latitude,p.coords.longitude);},
   function(){btn.removeAttribute('aria-busy');$$('.h-cerca-msg').forEach(function(m){m.hidden=false;m.textContent='No pudimos ver tu ubicación. Elige por la zona.';});},
   {timeout:9000,maximumAge:600000});});});
$$('.h-ad').forEach(function(f){var c=f.querySelector('.h-ad-caja'),r=f.querySelector('input'),m=f.querySelector('.h-ad-mango'),on=false;function pon(x){var b=c.getBoundingClientRect();var p=Math.round((x-b.left)/b.width*100);p=Math.max(2,Math.min(98,p));f.style.setProperty('--x',p+'%');r.value=p;}r.addEventListener('input',function(){f.style.setProperty('--x',r.value+'%');});m.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){on=true;try{m.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(x){}e.preventDefault();});m.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){if(on){pon(e.clientX);}});m.addEventListener('pointerup',function(){on=false;});m.addEventListener('pointercancel',function(){on=false;});c.addEventListener('click',function(e){pon(e.clientX);});});
/* Medición del home: un evento por clic, con su nombre fijo y su zona. */
var MEDIR=[['.h-cab .h-btn','reservar_cabecera','cabecera'],['.h-franja','promo_franja','franja'],['.h-acc .h-cta','reservar_portada','portada'],
['.h-acc .h-wa-c','whatsapp_portada','portada'],['#r-ir','reservador_ver_horarios','portada'],['.h-rapida .h-todos','whatsapp_reservador','portada'],
['.h-tab','pestana','servicios'],['.h-card','tarjeta_servicio','servicios'],['.h-fila','fila_servicio','servicios'],['.h-card-v','valoracion','servicios'],
['.h-ver-mas','ver_mas_servicio','servicios'],['.h-aviso a','mensaje_especial','mensaje'],['.h-promo-b','promo_reservar','promo'],
['.h-porque .h-mas','reservar_porque','porque'],['.h-ad-caja','antes_despues','resultados'],
['.h-extra a','mas_samsara','mas'],['.h-prod a','kalli_producto','kalli'],['.h-kalli-cta a','kalli_boton','kalli'],['.h-cerca','sede_mas_cercana','sedes'],['.h-aqui','reservar_en_sede','sedes'],['.h-sede-a a','enlace_sede','sedes'],
['.h-sede','hoja_elegir_sede','hoja'],['#hoja-ir','hoja_ver_horarios','hoja'],['.sm-faq-i summary','faq_pregunta','faq'],['.h-faq-cta a','cierre_faq','faq'],
['#barra .h-btn-o','reservar_barra','barra'],['#barra .h-wa-c','whatsapp_barra','barra'],['.h-pie a','enlace_pie','pie'],['.h-cajon a','enlace_menu','menu'],
['a','enlace_otro','otra'],['button','boton_otro','otra']];
var CAPA_H=window['dataLayer']=window['dataLayer']||[];
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var t=e.target;if(!t.closest){return;}
 for(var i=0;i!==MEDIR.length;i++){var n=t.closest(MEDIR[i][0]);if(!n){continue;}
  var txt=String(n.getAttribute('data-n')||n.getAttribute('aria-label')||n.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,60);
  CAPA_H.push({event:'home_clic',boton_id:MEDIR[i][1],boton_zona:MEDIR[i][2],boton_texto:txt,home_pagina:location.pathname});return;}},true);
var cajon=$('#cajon');$('#abrir-menu').addEventListener('click',function(){cajon.hidden=false;});
cajon.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===cajon||e.target.classList.contains('h-cerrar')||e.target.tagName==='A')cajon.hidden=true;});
})();
</script>
<script>(function(){var TZ='Europe/Madrid',LOC='es-ES',DIAS=[1,3],NOM=['domingo','lunes','martes','miércoles','jueves','viernes','sábado'],EN=['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
function dia(d){try{return EN.indexOf(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{timeZone:TZ,weekday:'short'}).format(d));}catch(e){return d.getDay();}}
function fecha(d){try{return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(LOC,{timeZone:TZ,day:'numeric',month:'long'}).format(d);}catch(e){return '';}}
function may(t){return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+t.slice(1);}
function corta(d){try{return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(LOC,{timeZone:TZ,day:'numeric',month:'short'}).format(d).replace('.','');}catch(e){return '';}}
var hoy=new Date(),h=dia(hoy),c=document.getElementById('h-fr-cuando'),pl=document.getElementById('h-fr-pill'),ct=document.getElementById('h-cuando-t');
if(!c){return;}
if(DIAS.indexOf(h)!==-1){c.textContent='Hoy '+NOM[h];pl.textContent='Solo hoy';pl.hidden=false;pl.className='h-fr-pill h-hoy';var pr=document.getElementById('promo');if(pr){pr.classList.add('h-es-hoy');}if(ct){ct.textContent='Hoy '+NOM[h]+' aplica el precio especial. Reserva tu hora para hoy.';}return;}
for(var i=1;8>i;i++){var d=new Date(hoy.getTime()+i*864e5),k=dia(d);if(DIAS.indexOf(k)!==-1){
 c.textContent=i===1?'Mañana '+NOM[k]:may(NOM[k])+' '+corta(d);pl.textContent='Próxima promo';pl.hidden=false;
 if(ct){ct.textContent='Próximo día con precio especial: '+(i===1?'mañana, ':'')+NOM[k]+' '+fecha(d)+'. Ya puedes reservar tu hora.';}return;}}
})();</script>
